title: puccinellia dolicholepis subsp. fominii
intro: Puccinellia dolicholepis subsp. fominii, commonly known as Fomin's puccinellia, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is a plant with various health benefits, including its use in traditional medicine to treat digestive issues and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Fomin's puccinellia include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for wound healing and antimicrobial applications. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
